roleTitle: Machine Learning Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform
jobDescription: The claims platform of a general insurer uses a triage model to route incoming motor claims to fast-track or full assessment. The Machine Learning Engineer owns the triage model end-to-end: training data, model design, release decisions and production monitoring, and is the accountable owner for the model's performance with the claims operations director.
requirements: Owns the triage model end-to-end, including training data, model design and release decisions.
Builds and maintains the training and evaluation pipelines for the triage model.
Monitors the model in production and runs the monthly model review with claims operations.
Coordinates model changes with claims operations and the model risk team and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents model cards, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each model version.

evidence.text: Built and maintained the training and evaluation pipelines for the motor-claims triage model (Python, scheduled on the platform's batch runner), including the feature refresh that adds repair-estimate and photo-metadata features.

Prepared the monthly model review pack (drift metrics, routing volumes, override rate) that the lead data scientist presented to claims operations; recommendations on threshold changes were the lead data scientist's.
Took model changes through the model risk team's review as the pipeline owner; release decisions were taken by the lead data scientist and approved by the model risk committee.
Wrote the model card sections on training data and known limitations for versions 2.1 and 2.2, including the limitation that photo-metadata features were missing for claims filed by phone.

Responsibilities included pipeline development, review-pack preparation, risk-review support and model-card documentation for the triage model over about two years as one of three engineers on the model team.
Work sample: the training pipeline's configuration and the model card for version 2.2, with the batch runner's job identifiers as a verification trail.

Hiring manager pre-read: a slide in the candidate's portfolio deck is titled 'Owner: motor-claims triage model' and lists 'model design, release decisions, production monitoring' under his name; in the screen he said the deck summarised 'what the team did'.

Recruiter note: the claims operations director has asked for an engineer who has been the accountable owner of a production model end-to-end; please make the ownership question explicit in the packet.
